android.persistence: dart:io file in Context.getFilesDir(), temp file + atomic rename

sizeClassification.note: Dart AOT snapshot: app code and the Flutter framework compiled together, not separable by file

ios.runtime: Dart AOT on devices; Dart JIT (debug) on the simulator
ios.streamClient: in-app replay of the bundled stream (default); dart:io WebSocket planned
ios.persistence: dart:io file in Library/Application Support, temp file + atomic rename
ios.buildClassNote: flutter_tools 3.47.7 builds only debug for simulators (release: 'RELEASE mode is not supported for simulators.')

sizeClassification.note: Dart AOT snapshot (device release); kernel blob in debug simulator builds

R1.note: Insights is embedded in the installed artifact

R2.reason: Flutter deferred components exist only for Android (and web) and are delivered as Android dynamic feature modules inside an App Bundle via store delivery; iOS unsupported. Loading Dart code from an arbitrary server is not a supported mechanism.

R7.reason: single runtime: no second UI runtime to communicate with

R8.note: bridge micro-benchmark not implemented yet (see bridge)

sync.mechanism: dart:ffi synchronous call into native code

async.mechanism: MethodChannel message to the platform thread and reply

android.A-F1: unavailable-expected (FrameTimeline does not cover SurfaceView content)
android.FrameTimingMetric: not-valid (no HWUI RenderThread frames for Flutter content)

adapters.name: benchkit-dart
adapters.note: interim dart:ffi backends to platform C APIs; switches to the core BenchKit C ABI at integration

deviations.text: iOS simulator builds are debug (JIT); release builds exist for devices only (unsigned here). Simulator results are buildClass debug.

Markers come from an interim Dart BenchKit (dart:ffi to ATrace/__android_log_write/clock_gettime on Android; ring buffer + syslog + notify_post + clock_gettime_nsec_np on iOS). bg/fg come from Flutter's AppLifecycleListener, not from platform lifecycle callbacks; marker ordinals restart in a new Flutter engine (activity recreation); a11y, input.*, proc.anchor and mem markers are not implemented.

The update stream is an in-app replay of the bundled first 10000 frames per profile on a monotonic absolute schedule (session semantics of the local server: hello, catch-up on reconnect, end frame). mb.server / mb.dataset=network are parsed but not used yet.
mb.bridgeBench is parsed but the C6 bridge micro-benchmark is not implemented.
Without out/keys/keystore.properties the release APK is signed with the debug key (Flutter template default).

confounds.text: Flutter enables its semantics tree unconditionally on the iOS simulator.
Flutter does not officially support release mode on emulators; Android emulator results of the release APK carry this limitation.
dart:io sockets do not consult Android's network security config or iOS ATS.
Flutter template AGP 9.1.0 / Kotlin 2.4.0 differ from the native projects' AGP and therefore the R8 version.
Activity recreation (A3) starts a new Flutter engine and Dart isolate and parses the fixture again.
libapp.so / App.framework holds app code and the Flutter framework together.
